corrections.why: ION (Ionia & Lydia, W. Anatolia) is assigned to neo_hittite_states, whose 'Great Kings' (Carchemish, Malatya, Tabal, Que) were confined to SE Anatolia and N Syria after the Hittite collapse; Carchemish never projected rule ~800km across the plateau to the Aegean coast. The west coast at this date held scattered post-Mycenaean/Luwian population (e.g. continued occupation at Miletus through LH IIIC), the same 'palaces burned, writing lost' condition the file already uses for greek_dark_age elsewhere in the Aegean, and consistent with the file's own uncertainty note that Ionian Greek settlement there only intensifies at -1000.

GEO (Colchis) is folded into Urartu's regions here, but Urartu's only attested push toward Qulha/Colchis is Sarduri II's 743 BC campaign (a raid extracting tribute, not lasting annexation, per Sarduri II's own inscriptions) — a generation after Sarduri I's -860/-830 founding era that this slice's own note cites. At -814 Colchis was still independent of Tushpa; reassign GEO to a Colchian tribal entity and keep Urartu to ARM/ARM_W, matching the file's own -750 treatment (Urartu at its Sarduri II peak) and its -700 reintroduction of colchian_tribes once Urartu recedes.

addEntities.note: Independent chiefdoms on the Phasis; Sarduri II's Colchis campaign is still a generation off

verified: All 8 slices (-1100..-600) assign exactly the 122 region codes with no gaps or duplicates (checked programmatically)

Founding years for canonical entities match the data-spec registry exactly: egypt -3100, assyria -2000, babylon -1894, carthage -814, urartu -860, lydia -680, media -678, athens -800, sparta -900, macedon -808, phrygia -1180, israel_judah -1020, phoenician_cities -1200

Political-event dates check out against mainstream chronology: Carthage's founding 814, Byzantium 667, Cyrene 631, Massalia c.600, first Olympiad 776, Adad-nirari II's reign 911-891, Sennacherib's 701 Judah campaign, Ashurbanipal's sack of Thebes 663, Psamtik I expelling Assyrian garrisons c.655, Scythians displacing Cimmerians off the Pontic steppe c.700
Kush/Egypt split at -750 (Kashta holding Thebes/EGY_S while Libyan dynasts hold the Delta/EGY_N) matches the conventional c.752 BC start of Kushite control of Upper Egypt
Cilicia (CIL) correctly shown under Assyria at -700/-650 (Que was an Assyrian province from the 8th century) before breaking free as the Syennesis kingdom by -600

The file's own uncertainties list already flags several genuinely defensible judgment calls (LEV as one coarse cell for Phoenicia/Philistia/Israel, Media's generous -600 hold on CAP/PON, BAL/MLT Carthaginian dating, Chernoles' Slavic vs Thracian attribution) that do not need further correction
